snippet.title: Road Truckers: New Beginning - Trailer for PC & PS5 | RPG about trucks!
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3333190?utm_source=yt
or on PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10012597

Road Truckers: New Beginning, a uniquely colorful simulator / RPG, is coming to Steam and PlayStation 5 in 2026! More platforms to follow.

Construct a vehicle, do cargo jobs and embark on personal quests to bring back prosperity in the region.
